Ex: He works for a company that publishes reference books.

profound

(adjective). Sâu sắc

Ex: Her sense of disappointment was profound.

ignorance

(noun). sự dốt nát

Ex: He showed a remarkable ignorance of the facts.

get a handle on

(phrase). nắm được chuôi một vấn đề

Ex: I can't get a handle on these sales figures.

ecology

(noun). Ngành sinh thái học

Ex: We were leaning about ecology in our biology class and this involved a trip to Dublin Zoo.

conservation

(noun). Sự bảo tồn

Ex: Road development in the area has been severely affected by the conservation programmes of the council.

confine

(verb). giới hạn

Ex: The work will not be confined to the HCMC area.

perceive

(verb). nhận thức

Ex: This discovery was perceived as a major breakthrough.

endangered

(adjective). Có nguy cơ tuyệt chủng

Ex: The sea turtle is an endangered species .

wealth

(noun). Sự giàu có

Ex: During a successful business career, she accumulated a great amount of wealth.

substantially

(adjective). nhiều, đáng kể

Ex: The costs have increased substantially.

raw

(adjective). thô, chưa tinh chế

Ex: Oil is an important raw material that can be processed into many different products, including plastics.

potential

(noun). Tiềm năng, triển vọng

Ex: The European marketplace offers excellent potential for increasing sales.

harvest

(verb). thu hoạch

Ex: In the US, winter wheat is harvested in the early summer.

facility

(noun). cơ sở vật chất

Ex: The school is upgrading its outdoor play facilities.

convert

(verb). Chuyển đổi

Ex: The hotel is going to be converted into a nursing home.

contribute

(verb). đóng góp

Ex: We contributed £5 000 to the earthquake fund.

available

(adjective). có sẵn

Ex: We'll send you a copy as soon as it becomes available.

associate

(noun). bạn đồng liêu, người cùng cộng tác

Ex: A close associate of the author denied reports that she had cancer.

alleviation

(noun). sự làm dịu, sự làm giảm bớt

Ex: Mental relaxation means alleviation of anxiety.

unique

(adjective). đặc biệt, độc nhất

Ex: Everyone's fingerprints are unique.

tend

(verb). có xu hướng

Ex: People tend to be happier if they are in a long-term relationship.

extensive

(adjective). bao quát, rộng rãi

Ex: Extensive research has been done into this disease.

erosion

(noun). Sự xói mòn

Ex: the erosion of the coastline by the sea Ex: If the soil is subject to wind and water erosion, it will be important to provide cover to protect the soil.

crucial

(adjective). Tối quan trọng

Ex: Parents play a crucial role in preparing their child for school.

market

(noun). thị trường

Ex: New companies have entered the market.

fiber

(noun). Vải sợi; Chất xơ

Ex: Natural fibers such as cotton tend to be cooler.

expansion

(noun). Sự mở rộng

Ex: a period of rapid economic expansion Ex: Expansion into new areas of research is possible"

sections.title: Passage 2: Children's Literature
sections.html:
urge

(verb). thúc giục

Ex: The charity urged the government to reconsider its decision.

threaten

(verb). đe dọa

Ex: Pollution is threatening marine life.

spirit

(noun). linh hồn, tinh thần

Ex: I'm trying to get into the spirit of the holiday season.

shift

(verb). dịch chuyển, di chuyển

Ex: The action of the novel shifts from Paris to London.

setting

(noun). khung cảnh

Ex: It was the perfect setting for a wonderful Christmas.

rid

(verb). bỏ đi

Ex: The problem is getting rid of nuclear waste.

register

(verb). được ghi nhận, được ghi trong tâm trí

Ex: I told her my name, but it obviously didn't register.

progressive

(adjective). tiến bộ

Ex: Are you in favour of progressive teaching methods?

previously

(adverb). trước đó

Ex: The building had previously been used as a hotel.

prejudice

(noun). Thành kiến

Ex: Their decision was based on ignorance and prejudice.

patron

(noun). Người bảo trợ; khách hàng

Ex: He was a great patron of the arts and helped to establish the Baltimore Museum.

odd

(adjective). Kì lạ

Ex: It seems odd that nobody noticed anything wrong.

morality

(noun). đạo đức

Ex: Standards of morality seem to be dropping.

maturity

(noun). sự trưởng thành

Ex: She has shown great maturity in her behaviour this term.

lullaby

(noun). bài hát ru

Ex: She sang her baby a lullaby.

levity

(noun). tính coi nhẹ, tính khinh suất

Ex: The joke provided a moment of levity in an otherwise dreary meeting.

instructional

(adjective). có tính chất hướng dẫn

Ex: The activities are intended to be both interesting and instructional.

inhabit

(verb). Trú ngụ

Ex: Some of the rare species that inhabit the area are under threat.

inevitable

(adjective). Không thể tránh khỏi

Ex: They came to see defeat as inevitable.

genuinely

(adverb). một cách thành thật, một cách chân thật

Ex: There are some genuinely funny moments in the film.

explore

(verb). khám phá

Ex: We will explore these ideas in more detail in chapter 7.

exclusiveness

(noun). tính loại trừ, tính dành riêng

Ex: They display an intolerant exclusiveness, and a belligerent sense of supremacy vis-à-vis the other.

exceedingly

(adverb). quá chừng, cực kì

Ex: He was clever, handsome, and exceedingly rich.

eventually

(adverb). Cuối cùng

Ex: It might take him ages but he'll do it eventually.

empathize

(verb). thông cảm, đồng cảm

Ex: It's very easy to empathize with the characters in her books.

eager

(adjective). háo hức

Ex: Everyone in the class seemed eager to learn.

divide

(verb). Phân chia

Ex: The questions divide into two categories: easy and hard.

determine

(verb). Quyết định

Ex: Upbringing plays an important part in determining a person's character.

critical

(adjective). mang tính nhận xét, đánh giá

Ex: His latest film attracted enthusiastic critical comment from cinema-goers.

contain

(verb). Chứa đựng

Ex: This drink doesn't contain any alcohol.

concentrate

(verb). Tập trung

Ex: We're concentrating even harder on giving quality service this year.

commit

(verb). cam kết

Ex: Both candidates refused to commit themselves to tax cuts.

coincide

(verb). Diễn ra 1 cách trùng hợp

Ex: The singer's arrival was timed to coincide with the opening of the festival.

chiefly

(adverb). một cách chủ yếu

Ex: We are chiefly concerned with improving educational standards.

cater

(verb). cung cấp, phục vụ

Ex: Most of our work now involves catering for weddings.

break out

(verb). bùng nổ

Ex: They had escaped to America shortly before war broke out in 1939.

availability

(noun). Tính khả dụng, sự có sẵn

Ex: I shall check the availability of my staff for that date.

anticipate

(verb). Dự đoán

Ex: We anticipate that sales will rise next year.

annual

(adjective). hàng năm

Ex: The 12th annual Music Festival runs from Friday 25th to Monday 28th October.

ancient

(adjective). cổ đại

Ex: People have lived in this valley since ancient times.

aim

(verb). nhắm vào, hướng vào

Ex: The government is aiming at a 50% reduction in unemployment.

aid

(noun). sự trợ giúp

Ex: This job would be impossible without the aid of a computer.

rhyme

(noun). vần

Ex: Can you think of a rhyme for ‘beauty’?

content

(noun). nội dung

Ex: She hadn't read the letter and so was unaware of its contents.

collection

(noun). sự sưu tầm, sự góp nhặt

Ex: He wanted to share his vast art collection with the world.

tribute

(noun). tôn trọng

Ex: This book is a tribute to the bravery of the pioneers.

publish

(verb). công bố

Ex: He works for a company that publishes reference books.

pirate

(verb). sao chép, mô phỏng bất hợp pháp

Ex: He was accused of pirating music, movies and other web material.

immediately

(adverb). ngay lập tức

Ex: They immediately began arguing.

formula

(noun). cách thức, thể thức

Ex: There's no magic formula for success.

flair

(noun). năng khiếu

Ex: She attributes her entrepreneurial flair and individualism to her upbringing.

edition

(noun). tái bản

Ex: The dictionary is now in its tenth edition.

rocket

(verb). vụt lên

Ex: The band rocketed to stardom with their first single.

popularity

(noun). sự phổ biến

Ex: Their music still enjoys widespread popularity among teenagers.

folklore

(noun). văn học dân gian, truyền thống dân gian

Ex: The story rapidly became part of family folklore.

select

(verb). chọn lọc

Ex: He hasn't been selected for the team.

swiftly

(adverb). nhanh

Ex: Walking swiftly, he was at the office within minutes.

scholarly

(adjective). học rộng, uyên thâm

Ex: He was a very scholarly young man.

unpleasant

(adjective). không dễ chịu

Ex: It can be unpleasant to sit next to a group of people arguing.

secure

(verb). bảo đảm

Ex: This form of investment is an excellent way of securing your children's financial future.

literary

(adjective). mang tính văn chương

Ex: Her internationally acclaimed novel has won several literary prizes.

intend

(verb). Dự định

Ex: The train we had intended to catch had already left.

arrival

(noun). sự đến, sự xuất hiện

Ex: The arrival of satellite television changed the face of broadcasting.

apotheosis

(noun). sự tôn sùng, sự lý tưởng thần thánh hóa

Ex: Most people agree that her acting career achieved its apotheosis in this movie.

adventure

(noun). Phiêu lưu

Ex: When you're a child, life is one big adventure.

describe

(verb). miêu tả

Ex: Can you describe him to me?

originally

(adverb). khởi đầu, nguyên thủy

Ex: The school was originally very small.

merchant

(noun). Thương gia

Ex: Venice was once a city of rich merchants.

giant

(noun). người khổng lồ

Ex: Tales are told about an island inhabited by a race of giants, as tall as houses.

uplifting

(adjective). làm phấn chấn

Ex: For me it was a marvellously uplifting performance.

prominent

(adjective). nổi bật

Ex: The church tower was a prominent feature in the landscape.

influence

(verb). ảnh hưởng

Ex: His film is heavily influenced by other film-makers.

diversion

(noun). sự làm xao nhãng

Ex: The fire was started to create a diversion, allowing some prisoners to escape.

decree

(verb). ra lệnh, quy định bằng sắc lệnh

Ex: The government decreed a state of emergency.

critic

(noun). nhà phê bình

Ex: The critics loved the movie.

contemporary

(adjective). đương thời

Ex: He is among the best-known contemporary artists.

condemn

(verb). chỉ trích

Ex: They rightly condemn such opinions as racist.

absurdity

(noun). sự lố bịch

Ex: It was only later that she could see the absurdity of the situation.

translate

(verb). dịch, phiên dịch

Ex: Her books have been translated into 24 languages.

seize on

(verb). bắt lấy, nắm lấy

Ex: The rumours were eagerly seized upon by the local press.

chance

(noun). cơ hội

Ex: Is there any chance of getting tickets for tonight?

decorum

(noun). sự đúng mực, sự lịch thiệp

Ex: He is not known for his sense of decorum.

violence

(noun). sự bạo lực

Ex: Violence broke out inside the prison last night.

concerned

(adjective). bận tâm, lo lắng

Ex: The president is deeply concerned about this issue.

stern

(adjective). nghiêm nghị, nghiêm khắc

Ex: The police are planning sterner measures to combat crime.

moralist

(noun). nhà luân lý học, nhà đạo đức học

Ex: The most famous legal moralist is Patrick Devlin, who argues that a shared morality is essential to the existence of a society.

indeed

(adverb). thật vậy, hiển nhiên

Ex: Thank you very much indeed!

recommend

(verb). gợi ý

Ex: I recommend the book to all my students.

necessary

(adjective). cần thiết

Ex: Food is necessary for survival.

echo

(verb). lặp lại

Ex: This is a view echoed by many on the right of the party.

defensive

(adjective). bảo vệ

Ex: Troops took up a defensive position around the town.

barrier

(noun). rào cản

Ex: Lack of confidence is a psychological barrier to success.

appeal

(verb). thu hút

Ex: The design has to appeal to all ages and social groups.

sections.title: Passage 3: Talc Powder
sections.html:
admittedly

(adverb). phải thừa nhận là

Ex: Admittedly, it is rather expensive, but you don't need to use much.

agronomics

(noun). nông nghiệp học

Ex: Geology, geography, and agronomics all study the earth, but their construction, their principle of scientific knowledge differs.

allegiance

(noun). lòng trung thành

Ex: He affirmed his allegiance to the president.

allow

(verb). Cho phép

Ex: This research must be allowed to continue.

annual

(adjective). hàng năm

Ex: The 12th annual Music Festival runs from Friday 25th to Monday 28th October.

array

(noun). một dãy, một nhóm cùng loại

Ex: Her writing covers a wide array of topics.

combat

(verb). đấu tranh

Ex: We must try to combat poverty and illiteracy.

commodity

(noun). hàng hóa

Ex: The country's most valuable commodities include tin and diamonds.

component

(noun). Thành phần

Ex: Nitrogen is the main component of air.

composition

(noun). sự hợp thành, sự cấu thành

Ex: Has household composition changed in the last decade?

constantly

(adverb). một cách liên tục

Ex: Fashion is constantly changing.

deposit

(noun). khoáng sản, mỏ

Ex: The region has many deposits of valuable oil.

display

(verb). Trưng bày

Ex: She proudly displayed her certificate to her parents.

establish

(verb). Thiết lập

Ex: Let’s establish some ground rules.

feature

(noun). đặc tính

Ex: Teamwork is a key feature of the training programme.

gather

(verb). Thu thập

Ex: People slowly gathered their belongings and left the hall.

harvest

(verb). thu hoạch

Ex: In the US, winter wheat is harvested in the early summer.

inert

(adjective). trơ, đơ

Ex: chemically inert radioactive waste Ex: Normally it is said that gold has no biochemical purpose, because it is chemically inert.

operate

(verb). Vận hành

Ex: Solar panels can only operate in sunlight.

pioneer

(verb). Tiên phong

Ex: It was universities that pioneered these new industries.

place a premium on

(phrase). coi trọng

Ex: They put a high premium on customer loyalty.

precious

(adjective). Quý giá

Ex: You're wasting precious time!

promising

(adjective). Đầy hứa hẹn, có tiềm năng

Ex: The research produced promising results.

reformulate

(verb). tái tạo, cải tạo

Ex: It is never too late to reformulate your goals.

relatively

(adjective). vừa phải, tương đối

Ex: I found the test relatively easy.

remarkable

(adjective). đáng chú ý, đặc biệt

Ex: He adapted to the new situation with remarkable speed.

secure

(verb). đạt được, đảm bảo

Ex: He was disappointed by his failure to secure the top job with the bank.

slightly

(adverb). nhỏ, không đáng kể

Ex: She earns slightly less than $100 000 a year.

supply

(verb). cung cấp

Ex: The company supplied schools with sports equipment.

tension

(noun). sự căng

Ex: When knitting, try to keep the same tension throughout.

vary

(verb). Thay đổi, khác nhau

Ex: The students' work varies considerably in quality.

vast

(adjective). rộng lớn

Ex: In the vast majority of cases, this should not be a problem.

versatility

(noun). tính linh hoạt

Ex: He is a designer of extraordinary versatility.

viable

(adjective). khả thi

Ex: There is no viable alternative.

attributable

(adjective). gây ra bởi

Ex: Their illnesses are attributable to a poor diet.

foam

(noun). bọt

Ex: The breaking waves left the beach covered with foam.

extraction

(noun). sự chiết, sự tách

Ex: The extraction of minerals has damaged the countryside.

content

(noun). nội dung

Ex: She hadn't read the letter and so was unaware of its contents.

norm

(noun). quy tắc, quy phạm

Ex: Small families are the norm nowadays.

recognize

(verb). nhận ra

Ex: Most of us recognise the importance of diet.

reluctant

(adjective). không nguyện ý, miễn cưỡng

Ex: He finally gave a reluctant smile.

stickiness

(noun). sự dính

Ex: The layer of stickiness on the floors has been removed.

manufacture

(noun). sự sản xuất

Ex: The amount of recycled glass used in manufacture doubled in five years.

process

(noun). quá trình

Ex: It's a normal part of the learning process.

dust

(verb). rắc, phủ

Ex: She dusted her cheekbones with blusher.

liberate

(verb). giải phóng

Ex: The city was liberated by the advancing army.

stir

(verb). Khuấy

Ex: Stir the paint before you use it.

boost

(verb). thúc đẩy

Ex: The movie helped boost her screen career.

yield

(noun). sản lượng, hoa lợi

Ex: a reduction in milk yield Ex: Organic farmers use natural controls and work with nature's cycles to produce healthful, abundant yields.

base

(noun). đáy, nền

Ex: Put some moisturizer on as a base before applying your make-up.

filler

(noun). chất làm đầy

Ex: Apply a coat of filler to all surfaces of the table.

provide

(verb). cung cấp

Ex: The exhibition provides an opportunity for local artists to show their work.

incidence

(noun). phạm vi ảnh hưởng, phạm vi tác động

Ex: The lack of vitamins may explain the higher incidence of heart disease.

initial

(adjective). ban đầu

Ex: Her initial response was one of anger.

lower

(verb). làm giảm

Ex: Boil for five minutes, then lower the heat and simmer for half an hour.

sunburn

(noun). sự cháy nắng

Ex: A long day at the beach gave him a bad sunburn.

trial

(noun). thử nghiệm

Ex: They're doing clinical trials on a new drug.

flat

(adjective). bằng phẳng

Ex: I need a flat surface to write on.

characteristic

(noun). Bản chất; Đặc trưng

Ex: All human languages share some common characteristics.

take advantage of

(verb). tận dụng

Ex: We took full advantage of the hotel facilities.

unique

(adjective). đặc biệt, độc nhất

Ex: Everyone's fingerprints are unique.

consequence

(noun). Hậu quả

Ex: Remember that actions have consequences.

due to

(phrase). vì

Ex: A lot of her unhappiness is due to boredom.

excess

(noun). dư thừa

Ex: Are you suffering from an excess of stress in your life?

extremely

(adverb). cực kỳ

Ex: It is extremely important to follow the directions exactly.

treat

(verb). xử lí

Ex: You need to treat this wood for woodworm.

yield

(verb). sản xuất, mang lại

Ex: The research has yielded useful information.

method

(noun). Phương pháp

Ex: Which method is the most effective?

operation

(noun). hoạt động

Ex: Weather conditions were too bad to mount a rescue operation.

directly

(adverb). một cách trực tiếp

Ex: He was not directly responsible for the accident.

dispose

(verb). vứt bỏ

Ex: Radioactive waste must be disposed of safely.

contain

(verb). Chứa đựng

Ex: This drink doesn't contain any alcohol.

biodegrade

(verb). phân hủy sinh học

Ex: Some plastics are designed to biodegrade when their useful life is over.

emulsify

(verb). nhũ tương hóa

Ex: With the blender running, slowly add the oil and blend until emulsified.

environment

(noun). môi trường

Ex: The government should do more to protect the environment.

harmful

(adjective). gây hại

Ex: Fruit juices can be harmful to children's teeth.

absorb

(verb). Hấp thụ

Ex: Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air.

lamination

(noun). Sự cán mỏng, sự dát mỏng

Ex: After lamination, snowboard edges are finished with metal or plastic.

manufacture

(verb). Sản xuất

Ex: This company manufactures the equipment used to make contact lenses.

packing

(noun). sự đóng gói

Ex: The price of each is £6 plus £1.50 each for postage and packing.

commercial

(adjective). mang tính thương mại

Ex: She is developing the commercial side of the organization.

intend

(verb). Dự định

Ex: The train we had intended to catch had already left.

potential

(noun). Tiềm năng, triển vọng

Ex: The European marketplace offers excellent potential for increasing sales.

primary

(adjective). chính

Ex: The primary aim of this course is to improve your spoken English.

represent

(verb). đại diện, biểu trưng

Ex: The artist uses doves to represent peace.

sector

(noun). khu vực

Ex: We have seen rapid growth in the services sector.
